prompts.image2d: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE landscape 3:2 hand-drawn 2D character concept turnaround sheet for 雷霆 (Lei Ting). Image 1 is the sole authoritative reference for EXACT identity, species, proportions, costume, colors, accessories and front/side/back arrangement. Translate the approved CGI design into polished traditional hand-drawn original character art, NOT another CGI render or filtered photo. Fine expressive ink/pencil linework, carefully painted muted watercolor/gouache shading, restrained pale warm paper background. Three full-body views of the SAME tall slender adult male anthropomorphic eel: FRONT left, SIDE middle, BACK right, matching height and baseline. Preserve elongated rounded eel head, long neck, olive charcoal smooth SCALELESS skin, pale throat, focused dark eyes, subtle self-assured expression. Preserve dark tailored three-piece suit, white shirt and pocket square, silver tie, silver lightning lapel pin, vest chain, wristwatch, trousers and black dress shoes. Two complete arms and hands, two complete legs and shoes, ONE long muscular eel tail naturally attached behind pelvis and curling sideways, fully visible in each view. Accurate consistent anatomy and costume across angles. No redesign, no crocodile or snake conversion, no scales, horns, external ears, electricity effects, extra props or characters. Keep generous margins and tails separated from adjacent figures; no cropping. No text, labels, logos or watermark. This is original 2D design documentation based on an approved 3D reference.

Sophisticated slightly sinister controlled arrogance, smooth elongated rounded eel head, small dark focused eyes, broad thin mouth, charcoal olive smooth scaleless damp-looking skin with restrained sheen, pale throat, no fur, no shark teeth, no dragon horns, no external ears. Upright humanoid torso with two anatomically coherent arms/hands, two legs with tailored trousers and shoes, long muscular eel tail emerging naturally behind pelvis and curving sideways with enough space. Slim tall adult build, subtle hints of electric-blue along tail edge not glowing lightning spectacle. Reference ONLY rendering quality not wolf species or crown. High-end feature-film 3D CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved fur or appropriate skin, woven cloth, crisp natural detail, soft warm key subtle cool fill, no plastic, no 2D outlines, no watermark.
